eligibility.default: returns SEC only when current actor local 30 equals 0001; otherwise CLC
eligibility.index_3: returns SEC when direct-page accumulator is zero and equals 11E8, or falls through to default local-30 test

limitations: The 15 phase indexes have no semantic labels from this routine alone.
The meaning of actor local 30 and global 11E8 is not established here.
This is an actor eligibility gate, not a complete phase-transition implementation.
